Derived from birth date 1972-10-17 on Wikidata (Q4900687). A fourth witness for age. Wikidata is community-edited, which is why this carries lower confidence than an affidavit or a parliamentary register. Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagwant_Mann

Wikidata (Q4900687), community-edited: a membership of Aam Aadmi Party recorded with no end date. Memberships Wikidata shows as ended are not used here, because a former party stated as a current one is a false claim about a living person.
